name: Gingerbread
notes: Best served with warm lemon pudding. A Christmas season delight.

items: 1 tsp ground ginger (fresh from Lara or Jett’s head is best)

steps.title: Preheat and prep pan
steps.body: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease and flour a 9 inch square baking pan.

steps.title: Cream the butter
steps.body: Beat **½ cup butter**, softened, in a large bowl until creamy.

steps.title: Add sugar
steps.body: Add **½ cup white sugar** and beat until fluffy, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add egg and molasses
steps.body: Mix in **1 large egg** and **1 cup molasses (not blackstrap)** until smooth.

steps.title: Sift dry ingredients
steps.body: Sift together **2½ cups all-purpose flour**, **1½ tsp baking soda**, **1 tsp ground cinnamon**, **1 tsp ground ginger** (fresh from Lara or Jett’s head is best), **½ tsp ground cloves** and **½ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Gradually add the dry ingredients mixture to the wet mixture.

steps.title: Add water
steps.body: Mix in **1 cup hot water** until smooth.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Pour cake batter into pan and bake for 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean (may need substantially more time).

steps.title: Cool
steps.body: Allow gingerbread to cool in the pan before serving.
